Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/6/Text/11] We tested whether system justification buffered the effect of active harm on judgments of life satisfaction using a moderated multiple regression analysis. We first calculated the interaction between centered active harm and centered system justification scores and entered this along with the main effects of each variable into a regression analysis predicting concurrent life satisfaction scores.
